name: okf-repositories
description: Orient to, query, maintain, validate, review, and publish Open Knowledge Format repositories safely.

interface.shortDescription: Work safely with Open Knowledge Format repositories.
interface.longDescription: Inspect an OKF repository, distinguish authored and generated layers, follow provenance and authority boundaries, make bounded changes, run repository-defined validation, and report publication state accurately.
interface.defaultPrompt: Orient to this OKF repository and complete the requested work without crossing its source, authority, or publication boundaries.
